scope: Native Linux and macOS control servers share listener ownership, private socket permissions, bounded stale-socket probing and inode-checked cleanup.

listenerCases: Preserves existing regular file and symlink

implementationEvidence: Abandoned-socket recovery initially failed because Foundation rewrote /private/tmp to /tmp for that existing socket; lexical path validation preserves exact ownership pathname.
limitations: Real Unix socket tests; no physical VM lifecycle qualification claimed.
Full operation/generation binding and command-execution deadlines remain open.
This does not establish protection against a malicious same-user process concurrently mutating the owned parent directory.
